item: wise/images/ (44 IRSA server cutouts of Epsilon Indi B)
reason: Same exposures as the full NEOWISE frames used here; the full frames carry the uncertainty and mask planes.
Four were cut at 5,000 rows. Replaced by complete Gaia DR3 queries (no row limit) with DSC and variability classes.

item: gaia/extras/ (XP and RVS spectra, epoch photometry, AP tables)
reason: Not needed for motion labels; class probabilities come from the new Gaia query. Kept in the source folder for spectral work.
Detection catalogues, not images. Suitable for a separate tabular track-linking task; not used here.
About 14 arcsec per pixel against 6.15 arcsec in the frames, and built from the same exposures, so not a valid independent subtraction template.
Already applied in the Level-2 frames.

item: spherex-context/ (SPLICES, spectral calibration tar, M101 cube)
reason: Selection-biased ice-candidate catalogue and laboratory calibration; no motion information.

item: neossat frames without a celestial WCS (214: all 192 of 1999 KW4, all 22 of the Tabby field)
reason: Cannot be placed on the sky without plate solving; listed in neossat/excluded-frames.csv.

item: asteroid positions from IMCCE SkyBoT (used in v1.0)
reason: Not a NASA or listed partner source and its reuse terms were not confirmed; removed in v1.1.
Kept in the stack arrays with qc_pass = False and the reason in qc_reasons; the loader drops them by default.
